# P2 · Doctor workspace and EMR core — R2 · Consult

**Window:** Weeks 9–15 · 21 Dec 2026 → 05 Feb 2027  
**Delivered to:** Doctors and nurses at the 2 partner clinics  
**Day one:** Open Doctor Today, see the patient chart, record vitals, write and sign a note, and print a prescription, without AI.  
**Goal:** A doctor completes a full visit, from chart to signed note and prescription, in Medvya. This is also the fallback that AI must never break.

**Tickets:** 28 · **Estimate:** 60 dev-days vs **35 working days** in the window (OVER by 25 days: needs scope trade-off or overlap) · **Average confidence:** 82%

## Exit criteria (release gate)

- [ ] ≥ 20 real visits per pilot doctor signed in Medvya — [MDV-P2-028](MDV-P2-028.md)
- [ ] Allergy and interaction checks fire in 100% of seeded conflict tests — [MDV-P2-016](MDV-P2-016.md), [MDV-P2-028](MDV-P2-028.md)
- [ ] Signed notes cannot be edited (only addendum), proven by automated test — [MDV-P2-012](MDV-P2-012.md), [MDV-P2-028](MDV-P2-028.md)
- [ ] Each doctor approves their own Rx print layout — [MDV-P2-017](MDV-P2-017.md), [MDV-P2-028](MDV-P2-028.md)

**Not in this phase:** AI drafting, billing, results inbox, e-prescription submission to regulators.
